This is a **JSON Schema** designed to bring structure, type safety, and rich auto-completion to your AI image generation workflow.

## How to use in VS Code
### 1. Installation
```
{
    "$schema": "./path-to-schema.json",
    // The rest of your properties with the help of IDE auto-completion
}
```
